evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 精神分析中的情感调节
evidence_atoms.claim: 精神分析中所说的情感调节是一种挣扎的过程，情感调节就像所有的心智活动一样，都面临着心灵的冲突本质：意识与潜意识的冲突。
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 如前述所提，精神分析中所说的情感调节是一种挣扎的过程。情感调节就像所有的心智活动一样，都面临着心灵的冲突本质：意识与潜意识的冲突。

evidence_atoms.claim: 情感调节应该是自我调节能力的「原质」或是「原型」，自我调节是一系列自我功能中的一部分，包括自信与自尊。
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 斯鲁夫的建议是，情感调节应该是自我调节能力的「原质」(anlage)或是「原型」。自我调节可说是一系列自我功能当中的一部分，其中也包括自信(self-reliance)与自尊(self-esteem)。

evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 同理心有许多定义，我们把同理心定义为一种机制，能够让个体接触他人的观点并做出推想，并在某种程度上会经验到对方的情绪状态，这种机制就是我们所说的IIM-a。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 安全依附与同侪能力的关系
evidence_atoms.claim: 婴儿时期的安全依附与往后跟同侪相处的能力有很强的关联，安全依附的孩子有较多社会导向行为、较能与人交流互惠、较受欢迎且较富有同理心。
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 另一派的研究证据指出，婴儿时期的安全依附与往后跟同侪相处的能力有很强的关联。比起不安全依附的孩子，过去有安全依附经验的孩子被观察到有较多的社会导向行为较能与人交流互惠、较受欢迎，而且较富有同理心。
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述。

evidence_atoms.claim: 所有与儿童的分析工作都包含发展性要素，即帮助儿童知道自我就是心智或心理上的实体。
clinical_signals: 儿童无法整合真实与假扮
therapeutic_implications: 分析历程中的回应是一种理解，不只是同理
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 所有与儿童的分析工作一定都包含了这种发展性的要素。而且对某些患者来说，在整个治疗历程中，治疗师几乎都关注在如何让他们知道，自我就是心智或心理上的实体。

title: 停止、倒带与探索
description: 在心智化失败后暂停，回到转折时刻，微切片探索事件与心理状态。
safety_notes: 仅供受训专业人员规划会谈过程，不作为直接回复模板。

evidence_atoms.claim: 治疗师使用“停止、倒带和探索”技术对与警察和店主的互动进行微切片，帮助苏珊探索她的“什么都没做”意味着她没有像姐姐那样吸大麻，但当店主靠得太近时，她让他退后一步。
clinical_signals: 患者声称自己什么都没做
therapeutic_implications: 通过微切片探索患者对事件的解释
帮助患者识别自己实际采取的行动
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The therapist slowed down the process by bringing herself back into their present interaction (“This is way too fast for me”) and engaged Susan in the process of micro-slicing the interaction with the police and the store manager using the technique “stop, rewind and explore”. In doing this, Susan explored that her “doing nothing” meant that she wasn’t smoking pot like her sister, however, when the store manager stepped up “too close” to her sister and told her to stop, Susan told him to take a step back, which he did.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了微切片技术的使用和效果。

evidence_atoms.claim: 治疗师使用“停止、倒回和探索”技术，让苏珊微观切片她与警察和店主的互动。
clinical_signals: 患者快速报告事件，未详细描述
therapeutic_implications: 通过微观切片互动，促进对事件的详细探索
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The therapist slowed down the process by bringing herself back into their present interaction (“This is way too fast for me”) and engaged Susan in the process of micro-slicing the interaction with the police and the store manager using the technique “stop, rewind and explore”.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了技术名称及其应用。

evidence_atoms.claim: 当成员无法连接时，治疗师可以暂停、搜索和倒带，以理解发生了什么导致成员感到“出局”。
therapeutic_implications: 暂停当前互动
搜索理解原因
倒带回顾
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: ‘I can see you seem “out” Kimberley’, can we pause, search and rewind to try and understand what happened for you to feel “out”.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用治疗师的话。

evidence_atoms.claim: 当临床医生处于相当大的怀疑和不确定时，应停止挖掘，回到基本原则，并结合“停止、倒回（到对话可理解的点）和探索”，然后再继续前进。
clinical_signals: 临床医生感到相当大的怀疑和不确定
therapeutic_implications: 帮助临床医生重新定位思维
从静止位置更容易回到正轨
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: whenever the clinician is in considerable doubt and uncertainty, he/she should stop digging a hole, return to the basic principles, and couple this with a “Stop, Rewind (to a point at which the dialogue was understandable) and Explore” (see Chapter 6) before moving forward again.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了干预原则。

evidence_atoms.claim: 通过探索和微切片事件，最终可以在之前无法心理化的情境中建立心理化，从而可能带来新的视角。
clinical_signals: 患者之前无法在特定情境中心理化
therapeutic_implications: 通过微切片建立心理化
促进新的视角
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: By exploring and micro-slicing such events, eventually mentalizing can be established in situations where no mentalizing was possible before, which may lead to a new perspective.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了探索和微切片事件的效果。

evidence_atoms.claim: 如果挑战干预使非心智化停止，临床医生应暂停会话，否则非心智化会很快恢复。
therapeutic_implications: 挑战后需暂停会话以巩固效果
response_constraints: 临床医生应暂停会话
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Our descriptor “Stop and Stand” is a reminder that if the nonmentalizing comes to a halt as a result of the intervention, the clinician is asked to hold the session almost in freeze-frame, otherwise the nonmentalizing will soon resume.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述挑战后的暂停策略。

evidence_atoms.claim: 通过探索和微切片事件，最终可以在之前无法进行心智化的情境中建立心智化，并可能带来新的视角。
therapeutic_implications: 逐步建立心智化能力
促进新视角的形成
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: By exploring and micro-slicing such events, eventually mentalizing can be established in situations where no mentalizing was possible before, which may lead to a new perspective.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述了微切片的作用。

evidence_atoms.claim: 只有当心智化严重中断时，才进行停止、倒回、探索。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生停止并倒回会话过程或叙事内容
要求更多细节
共同理解会话过程或识别重要事件元素
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: It is only when mentalizing is seriously disrupted that a “Stop, Rewind, Explore” takes place.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明停止、倒回、探索的适用条件。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 停止并倒回到心智化丧失之前
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Stop and Rewind to point before mentalizing was lost
evidence_atoms.claim: 停止并倒回到心智化丧失之前的点。
therapeutic_implications: 停止并倒回到心智化丧失之前的点
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Stop and Rewind to point before mentalizing was lost

evidence_atoms.claim: 治疗师建议暂停并倒回到父亲生气之前的时刻。
clinical_signals: 会话变得激烈，情绪高涨
therapeutic_implications: 减缓互动，为反思创造空间
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: suggests they might pause and rewind to the point before he became angry.

evidence_atoms.claim: 临床医生需要通过持续使用“停止”和“回放”并加以澄清来维持控制，防止小组互动过快导致反思丧失。
therapeutic_implications: 使用“停止”和“回放”技术维持控制
澄清互动内容
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The clinician needs to maintain control through the constant use of “stop” and “rewind” with clarification.

evidence_atoms.claim: 当过度思考时，可以暂停并提醒自己无法真正看透他人的想法。
therapeutic_implications: 使用如“我们可以暂停一下吗？我想知道你是否开始过度思考了。当我们过度思考时，会对别人的想法做出大量假设，并把这些假设当作事实。”
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: “Can we pause for a minute, I was wondering if you are beginning to overthink a bit, and you know when we overthink, we start making massive assumptions about other people’s minds and then we start to treat these assumptions as if they are facts, when they aren’t– we cannot really see into other people’s minds.”
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接引用了应对过度思考的陈述。

evidence_atoms.claim: 当临床医生感到压力时，可以按下心智化“暂停按钮”，以更好地理解青少年及其家庭的挣扎和感受。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生应监控自身心智化压力，并主动暂停以寻求理解
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: By pressing a mentalizing “pause” button (Bateman & Fonagy, 2006), we tried to imagine and better understand some of the struggles and feelings of the young people and families we work with in the here and now
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 原文描述了临床医生使用心智化暂停按钮来理解青少年和家庭。

evidence_atoms.claim: 通过按下心智化“暂停”按钮，治疗师可以尝试想象并更好地理解青少年及其家庭当下的挣扎和感受，并力求做到真正的共情和支持。
clinical_signals: 治疗师感到压力或担心不被视为足够肯定
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师暂停并反思自身和青少年的体验
在咨询室中共同反思
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: By pressing a mentalizing “pause” button (Bateman & Fonagy, 2006), we tried to imagine and better understand some of the struggles and feelings of the young people and families we work with in the here and now, and aimed to be genuinely empathic and supportive.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了心智化暂停作为一种治疗立场，用于理解青少年和家庭。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 鼓励暂停并澄清听到的内容
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: encouraging pause and clarifying what was heard
evidence_atoms.claim: 当患者准备离开时，治疗师鼓励暂停，并请患者澄清听到他人说了什么。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励暂停
要求澄清听到的内容
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The therapist encourages Kelly to pause, looking as though she is about to leave, ‘Whoa, wait Kelly, please I’d like you to stay… what is it you’ve heard Tamara say?’

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 停止并探索心智化正在发生的点
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Stop and Explore a point when mentalizing was taking place

therapeutic_implications: 停止并探索心智化正在发生的点
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: ◆ Stop and Explore a point when mentalizing was taking place

evidence_atoms.claim: 有时治疗师需要暂停小组，要求所有成员参与外显心智化过程。
clinical_signals: 小组互动出现误解或不确定
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师主动暂停并引导外显心智化
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Point out here that at times it will be necessary for the group leader to stop the group and to ask everyone to engage in an explicit mentalizing process.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接描述治疗师在小组中的干预技术。

evidence_atoms.claim: 在MBT-ASPD团体中，应避免使用暂停合同。
therapeutic_implications: 不要使用暂停合同
response_constraints: 避免暂停合同
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Avoid: ● Time-out contracts
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确列出避免暂停合同。

evidence_atoms.claim: 在困难交流中按下想象中的“暂停按钮”有助于家庭成员保持心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 使用角色扮演演示暂停按钮
鼓励家庭生成自己的例子
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: a role play is used to demonstrate to family members the importance of pressing an imaginary “pause button” during difficult exchanges.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确描述角色扮演演示暂停按钮的重要性。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 临床医生在停止、倾听、观察中的角色
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: clinician's role in Stop, Listen, Look
evidence_atoms.claim: 在停止、倾听、观察中，临床医生既要积极探索当前状态，又要仔细倾听回应，以理清互动复杂性并理解干扰心智化的情感过程。
therapeutic_implications: 积极探索当前状态
仔细倾听回应
理清互动复杂性
理解干扰心智化的情感过程
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: On the one hand, the clinician has to be active about this exploration of the current state of the group or individual session, but on the other hand, he/she must also listen to the responses carefully to piece together the complexity of the interactions and make sense of the affective process that is interfering with each person’s capacity to think about themselves in relation to the others.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了临床医生的双重角色。

evidence_atoms.claim: 当患者从假扮模式转回精神等同模式，恐慌直线上升，必须找到涵容者才能够停止。
clinical_signals: 患者恐慌直线上升，感觉生命陷入危险
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师需提供涵容以停止恐慌
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: 突然间，幻想成为了真实：她转回了精神等同的模式，感受到她的生命似乎陷入了危险。「有个人将会被杀掉！」恐慌直线上升，而这样的恐慌必须找到涵容者才能够停止。
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述恐慌需要涵容。

title: 误解、破裂与修复
description: 识别沟通误解或关系破裂，承认自身贡献并恢复共同探索。
safety_notes: 仅供受训专业人员处理治疗关系破裂。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 停留在破裂中寻找视角
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Staying in the rupture to find a vantage point
evidence_atoms.claim: 修复治疗联盟需要停留在破裂中，并寻找一个观察破裂的视角。
therapeutic_implications: 临床医生和患者需要移动到破裂‘热度’之间的位置
双方成为侦探，寻找线索
response_constraints: 首先必须修复治疗联盟，而不是增加使用技术
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: First, the therapeutic alliance must be repaired by staying in the rupture and seeking a vantage point from which to view it.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明修复联盟需要停留在破裂中。

evidence_atoms.claim: 当临床医生误用代词后，真诚道歉并保持好奇，探究错误为何如此困扰年轻人，有助于修复治疗联盟。
clinical_signals: 年轻人因误用代词而生气或攻击
therapeutic_implications: 真诚道歉
保持好奇
在后续会谈中重新审视错误
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: the clinician tried to apologise to the young person authentically, but also remain curious about why this mistake had upset the young person so much. The therapeutic alliance was restored by acknowledging the young person’s distress and revisiting this mistake in a different session.

evidence_atoms.claim: 当发生误称性别代词事件后，临床工作者真诚道歉并保持好奇，探索该错误对青少年的意义，可修复治疗联盟。
clinical_signals: 青少年因误称代词而愤怒
therapeutic_implications: 真诚道歉
保持好奇
在后续会谈中重新探讨该错误
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The therapeutic alliance was restored by acknowledging the young person’s distress and revisiting this mistake in a different session. Exploring the meaning this had for the young person (namely that he did not “pass” well enough as a boy, his fear of humiliation, and a painful sense of not being accepted by others) helped the young person feel understood.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了修复联盟的过程。

evidence_atoms.claim: 治疗师必须意识到自己犯了错误，并承担责任以修复与患者的连接。
clinical_signals: 患者行为举止突然改变
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师应道歉并请求帮助理解错误所在
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: We must pick up when we have made an error and then take responsibility for it to try and repair the connection with the patient. If a patient says: “You have not understood me”. We would say: “I am so sorry, I really want to understand you, please help me see where I got it wrong”.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了治疗师在误解患者后应如何回应。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 在误解或不确定时进行外显心智化
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: be explicit at points of misunderstanding or uncertainty
evidence_atoms.claim: 在误解或不确定的时刻，最好进行外显心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗师应鼓励患者在误解或不确定时外显化心智过程
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: It is best to be explicit at points of misunderstanding or uncertainty.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接指导在误解或不确定时使用外显心智化。

evidence_atoms.claim: 澄清误解和敏感的内心感受是MBT的核心要素。
therapeutic_implications: 治疗中应主动澄清误解和敏感感受
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Clarifying misunderstandings and sensitive interpersonal feelings is a central element of MBT.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确陈述澄清误解是核心要素。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 破裂时避免增加技术使用
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Avoid increasing technique use during rupture
evidence_atoms.claim: 破裂时最大的危险是增加使用自认为对患者改变至关重要的技术，例如移情解释、行为挑战或认知扭曲描述。
therapeutic_implications: 应首先修复联盟，而非加强技术
response_constraints: 避免增加使用移情解释、行为挑战或认知扭曲描述
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The gravest danger at these times is increasing your use of the techniques that you believe are crucial to patient change, for example, transference interpretation, behavioral challenge, or delineation of cognitive distortions.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确警告破裂时增加技术使用的危险。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Rupture as a failure of mentalizing
evidence_atoms.claim: 破裂代表心智化的失败。
therapeutic_implications: 需要恢复心智化
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Ruptures represent a failure of mentalizing.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确陈述破裂是心智化失败。

evidence_atoms.claim: 心智化与误解密切相关，讨论为何我们经常误解他人和自己，可以鼓励探讨心智的特点、个体不同的价值观和生活经验，以及人们用来隐藏自己的不同策略。
therapeutic_implications: 团体领导者可引导成员讨论误解的原因，以促进对心智化的理解
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The group leader introduces the next topic: that mentalizing has a lot to do with misunderstandings. “Let’s discuss why we so often misunderstand others and ourselves. evidence_atoms.claim: 第三阶段旨在处理由治疗即将结束引发的丧失、分离、自主性和身份认同问题，通过鼓励患者表达与治疗终止相关的恐惧和愿望。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励表达恐惧和愿望
处理丧失和分离
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Working through issues around loss and separation, as well as autonomy and identity, that are triggered by the impending end of the treatment (e.g., fears of losing the clinician, fears of relapsing, fear of failure when going back to work, etc.) by encouraging the patient to express his/her fears and wishes relating to the upcoming termination of treatment.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了第三阶段的目标。

title: 支持网络与多方协作
description: 在复杂情境中识别可信人类支持，减少专业网络的非心智化冲突。
safety_notes: 仅供专业协作或督导，不作为面向青少年的直接回复模板。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 适应性心智化整合治疗
evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT是一种基于心智化的模型，适用于有多重复杂困难的青少年，通过四个层面（青少年及其家庭、团队、网络、学习立场）提供工具来刺激心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 拓宽干预领域，提供刺激心智化的工具
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT is a mentalization-based model for teams working with young people who have multiple and complex difficulties. AMBIT broadens the field of intervention by providing tools to stimulate mentalizing, applying principles and practices based on four different levels: working with young people and their families, working with teams, working with our network and supporting teams to adopt a learning position regarding our own practice.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了AMBIT的定义和四个层面。

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT是一种系统性的方法，旨在围绕困境青少年及其家庭发展和调整帮助系统，使其更有帮助、更被使用、更有效。
clinical_signals: 青少年问题复杂、高风险、低参与度
therapeutic_implications: 服务应关注青少年对帮助本身的关系
促进多机构协作
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT is less a concrete (teleological) organisational model and more a systematic approach to the development and adaptation of systems of help around troubled adolescents and their families so that these can be experienced as more helpful, and thus be better used and more effective
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接描述AMBIT的本质。

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT是一套系统应用的原则和方法，旨在帮助工作人员更容易识别服务系统何时解体（停止相互心智化），并拥有干预工具以恢复心智化。
therapeutic_implications: 使用AMBIT工具恢复心智化
系统层面的干预
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT can best be described as a set of principles and methods applied systemically that stimulate awareness of the above problems and help staff working with these kinds of clients to recognise more easily when and where the service systems dis-integrate (stop mentalizing each other), and then have tools to intervene to restore mentalizing.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述AMBIT的定义和功能

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Work under the influence of AMBIT
evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT项目支持团队在AMBIT的影响下工作，并根据情境进行调整，而非创建标准的AMBIT团队。
therapeutic_implications: 鼓励团队根据情境调整AMBIT
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: the AMBIT programme at the Anna Freud National Centre for Children and Families is keen to stress that they are interested in supporting teams to “work under the influence of AMBIT” - adapted to suit the context - rather than in creating “AMBIT teams”.

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT的八项指导原则（“不稳固工作者的抓手”）涵盖了团队如何与客户、同事以及跨多机构系统合作。
therapeutic_implications: 指导团队与客户、同事及多机构系统合作
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: These cover how such teams work not only with the client, but with their own colleagues, and across often large and complex multi-agency systems.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接说明了八项原则的覆盖范围。

evidence_atoms.claim: 在共同思考的第三步“心智化当下”中，首先心智化求助的同事（而非来访者），这是帮助被接受和消化的前提。
clinical_signals: 督导中急于关注来访者而忽略同事状态
therapeutic_implications: 先与求助同事建立调谐
再共同心智化问题中的其他心智
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: First the helping colleague(s) mentalize the help-seeking colleague (not the client, which is tempting, but they are not present); this is the pre-requisite for any help that might be offered being accepted and digested.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了步骤顺序和原理。

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT是一种团队方法，尽管它强调可能产生认识信任的强个体关键关系。
therapeutic_implications: 干预应基于团队，同时培养关键个体关系
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT is a team approach, even though it emphasises strong individual “key” relationships where epistemic trust may arise.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 原文明确将AMBIT描述为团队方法。

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT 原则成对出现，彼此处于张力之中，共同描述工作者试图保持平衡的立场。
clinical_signals: 工作者在原则间感到矛盾
therapeutic_implications: 接受工作的不可能性
在原则间灵活调整
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: Each of the four quadrants is associated with a pair of principles, which are always in tension with each other. Collectively these principles describe an AMBIT stance that a worker tries to hold in balance.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述AMBIT原则的成对性和张力。

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT 强调与青少年建立关系，但同样重视工作者及其团队和网络的关系。
clinical_signals: 工作者过度关注青少年而忽视自身支持
therapeutic_implications: 平衡对青少年和工作者关系的关注
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: AMBIT has its foundations in mentalizing and attachment theory (Bevington, Fuggle, & Fonagy, 2015), and thus there is a strong emphasis on the building of relationships, and the first one (inevitably) is the one with the young person. However, if it has anything substantively new to add, AMBIT seeks to shift attention toward equality of emphasis in its application toward the workers – across teams, and whole network or systems of help – as well as toward their clients.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确说明AMBIT对青少年和工作者关系的平等重视。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: Working under the influence of AMBIT
evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT项目支持团队“在AMBIT的影响下工作”，即根据情境进行调整，而不是创建“AMBIT团队”。
therapeutic_implications: 实施应灵活适应本地情境，而非严格遵循固定模式。
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: the AMBIT programme at the Anna Freud National Centre for Children and Families is keen to stress that they are interested in supporting teams to “work under the influence of AMBIT” - adapted to suit the context - rather than in creating “AMBIT teams”.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确强调适应性实施而非标准化复制。

evidence_atoms.canonical_name_zh: 家庭干预的潜在益处（社会支持）
evidence_atoms.canonical_name_en: potential benefit of family intervention (social support)
evidence_atoms.claim: NICE指南指出，促进社会支持网络的结构化心理教育项目可能对家庭有帮助。
therapeutic_implications: 促进社会支持网络
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: “[S]tructured psychoeducation programmes that also facilitate social support networks may be helpful for families.” (p. 96)
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 使用“可能”表示不确定性。
population_details: 边缘型人格障碍患者的家庭

evidence_atoms.claim: AMBIT模型强调关键工作者与患者形成基于心智化的关系，但这种关系必须由响应性和支持性的团队来维持。
therapeutic_implications: 关键工作者关系需要团队支持
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: The AMBIT model places a strong emphasis on the role of the keyworker, that is, an individual who is the primary clinician delivering and overseeing the patient’s treatment, and the mentalizing-based relationship he/she forms with the patient. However, according to this model, this central keyworker relationship must be sustained by a responsive and supportive team
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 明确描述了AMBIT模型对关键工作者和团队关系的观点。

evidence_atoms.claim: 分离焦虑/悲伤作为求助信号，向潜在照顾者表明个体处于危险、需要保护或与群体/家庭隔离。
evidence_atoms.evidence_excerpt: These emotions function as an appeal for others to take care of us. They signal to potential caregivers that one is in danger/in need of protection or that one has become isolated from the group/family, or that one has lost someone close who one depends on.
evidence_atoms.extraction_notes: 直接陈述。
